title: Knowledge Phase 2 rerank eval — fixed query set
note: Hermetic labeled corpus for measured comparison. Prod RAG queries can be appended later via scripts/eval-knowledge-rerank.py --from-prod; they do not replace this fixed set.

queries.query: How does hybrid search combine vector similarity and BM25 keyword ranking?
Review stale opportunities weekly with no activity in fourteen days
Connector knowledge sync ingests Notion Confluence HubSpot Zendesk
When PagerDuty alerts fire summarize severity and customer impact
QuickBooks and NetSuite read-only connectors during pilots

corpus.title: Hybrid retrieval overview
corpus.content: Gravitre hybrid search retrieves semantic vector neighbors and BM25 keyword matches, then merges ranked lists before optional cross-encoder reranking.

corpus.title: RRF merge
corpus.content: Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) combines vector similarity ranks and BM25 keyword ranks into a single candidate list for the reranker.

corpus.title: ms-marco cross-encoder
corpus.content: The default RAG cross-encoder is cross-encoder/ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2. It scores query-document pairs and filters by rag_rerank_score_threshold.

corpus.title: Stale opportunities
corpus.content: Pipeline hygiene playbook: review opportunities with no activity in fourteen days and escalate owners weekly.

corpus.title: Pipeline hygiene
corpus.content: Weekly stale opportunity review keeps CRM forecast accurate. Skip closed-won and closed-lost records.

corpus.title: Connector knowledge sync
corpus.content: Connector knowledge sync ingests Notion, Confluence, HubSpot, and Zendesk articles into org RAG sources for retrieval.

corpus.title: PagerDuty incident summary
corpus.content: When PagerDuty alerts fire, summarize severity, impacted customers, and open incidents before paging on-call.

corpus.title: Finance connector pilots
corpus.content: During pilots, QuickBooks and NetSuite connectors stay read-only. Writes remain behind approval gates.

corpus.title: Human confirmation
corpus.content: Connector write actions require human confirm. The assistant presents a pending task; execute_plan runs only after confirmation.

corpus.title: execute_plan gate
corpus.content: execute_plan is the shared write gate for conversational operator confirms. Recommendation cards must not bypass it.

corpus.title: Department members
corpus.content: Lite seat department_members control which users see department-scoped agents and packs. Add and remove emit audit events.

corpus.title: Apollo lists
corpus.content: Apollo people search and list creation are unrelated to RAG hybrid retrieval math.

corpus.title: Slack channels
corpus.content: Posting Slack messages uses chat_action_mapper catalog kinds and does not describe BM25 or RRF.

corpus.title: Billing plans
corpus.content: Meson and Control plan limits are billing topics, not retrieval ranking.
